titulo_es: Read and write a formal message

texto: Head: **Gentile Signore / Gentile Signora** (Dear Lord / a), **Egregio Dottore**.
Farewell: **Distinti saluti** (Greetings), **Cordiali saluti** (Cordial greetings), **In attesa di un Suo riscontro** (Pending your news).
**Le scrivo in merito a...** (I write to you in relation to...), **Gradirei sapere se...** (I would be grateful to know if...), **In allegato trasmetto...** (attached reference...).

filas: Le escribo con respecto a la candidatura.

frases.it: Gentile Signor Rossi, Le scrivo in merito alla Sua richiesta di colloquio.
frases.es: Estimado señor Rossi, le escribo en relación con su solicitud de entrevista.
frases.en: Dear Mr. Rossi, I write to you about your request for an interview.

frases.it: La ringrazio vivamente per la rapida risposta e resto a disposizione.
frases.es: Le agradezco vivamente la rápida respuesta y quedo a su disposición.
frases.en: I thank you very much for the quick response and I am at your disposal.

frases.it: Gradirei sapere se può venire venerdì mattina presso i nostri uffici.
frases.es: Agradecería saber si puede venir el viernes por la mañana a nuestras oficinas.
frases.en: I'd be grateful if you could come to our offices on Friday morning.

frases.it: Certamente, confermo la mia presenza. Distinti saluti.
frases.es: Por supuesto, confirmo mi asistencia. Le saluda atentamente.
frases.en: Of course, I confirm my attendance. He greets you carefully.

bloques.pregunta: What header formula is suitable to start a formal mail addressed to a professional?

opciones.explicacion: Treatment of regular formal respect in Italian correspondence.
Colloquial record to be totally inadequate at work.
affective treatment reserved for personal privacy.

bloques.pregunta: What does the «distinti saluti» closing formula mean?

opciones.texto: Greetings to you carefully / Greetings to you.
opciones.explicacion: Protocolary courtesy fired in official and work letters.
Unfriendly informal farewell from a professional message.

opciones.texto: Until next week if God wants.
opciones.explicacion: It deflects the epistolar canonical formula of courtesy.

bloques.frase: Le scrivo ___ chiedere chiarimenti riguardo all'incarico proposto.

opciones.explicacion: Preposition that governs the infinitive «chiedere» expressing the motive of the letter.
It would require the «a causa di» locution and denote injury, not purpose.
It indicates physical spatial direction, outside of the communicative intention.

bloques.frase: Gradirei sapere se può confermare l'appuntamento per domani.

opciones.texto: I'd appreciate it if you could confirm if you could come to the meeting tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: Use of «gradirei» courtesy conditional with «Lei» treatment.

opciones.texto: I'm ordering you to come to my office right now.
opciones.explicacion: A despotic tone opposed to the diplomatic elegance of the conditional.

opciones.texto: I reject your appointment because I have no interest in the project presented.
opciones.explicacion: It inverts the affirmative sense of coordinating the meeting.

bloques.pregunta: What does the formal «La ringrazio vivamente» thank you formula express?

opciones.texto: Le agradezco a usted con sincera cordialidad.
opciones.explicacion: Use of «La» capital courtesy with the verb of gratitude.

opciones.texto: I thank you as a good friend.
opciones.explicacion: I'd use informal «ti ringrazio».

opciones.texto: I thank myself for the management.
opciones.explicacion: Shame-on reflexive feeling.

bloques.frase: In attesa di una Sua gentile risposta
bloques.explicacion: Order the terms of the farewell formula.

bloques.frase: In ___ trasmetto il mio curriculum aggiornato con le ultime pubblicazioni.

opciones.explicacion: Necessary technical term in e-mail: «in allegato».
It would mean «as added», it is not the term itself for an annex file.
It means «All right.», not attached to the computer documents.

bloques.pregunta: What is the most appropriate formal opening greeting to an unknown professional woman?

opciones.explicacion: Universal generic courtesy respectful treatment.
I'm turning a little rough and a little bit of a grammatical to head a letter.
Unacceptable colloquial intervention in the administrative register.

intro: In Italian e-mails and formal letters, fixed formulas of heading, exposure of motive and respectful farewell are used.
